title: Social Connection, Mobility and Personal Future Capacity
summary: Social connection affects whether usable support exists in a crisis, social mobility examines how strongly starting position constrains later paths, and personal future capacity asks how many executable choices remain under current conditions.

blocks.text: Social connection affects whether usable support exists in a crisis, social mobility examines how strongly starting position constrains later paths, and personal future capacity asks how many executable choices remain under current conditions.

Future capacity is neither a prediction of success nor a rating of personal worth. It describes whether pathways exist, whether transition costs are bearable, and whether alternatives remain when one path fails.

This article remains within the completed Book VI manuscript; B6-WEB-B does not add live current-data population. Subjective experience and structural conditions remain distinct, and no single measure is used to infer a person or an entire society.
